records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales in the three months ended September 30, 2023 increased $2.1 million, or 2.6%, to $81.9 million from $79.8 million in the three months ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Unit sales decreased 6.5% and average unit price increased by 9.4% in the three months ended September 30, 2023 as compared to the same period in the prior fiscal year, resulting in an increase in our net sales of 2.6%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of September 30, 2023, the Company had committed to purchase green coffee inventory totaling $36.5 million under fixed-price contracts, and $15.8 million in inventory and other purchases under non-cancelable purchase orders.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2023 was primarily due to higher pricing compared to the prior period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash used in operating activities during the three months ended September 30, 2023 was $7.1 million as compared to $6.3 million in the three months ended September 30, 2022, an increase in cash used in operations of $0.9 million.
